From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

On Tue, May 18, 2026 at 10:31 AM Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@equatorx.com> wrote:
> Thanks — talk shortly.

Notes from today’s 30m sync (Hannah / Marissa / Ben):
- Attendees: Alex Morgan (EquatorX), Priya Singh (EquatorX - Procurement), Hannah Schmitt (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Confirmed scope: CAIQ v3 walkthrough; focus on logs, keys, and deployment isolation.
- Data residency / logs: Redwood stores telemetry in regioned S3 buckets tied to the customer’s region. For EquatorX they requested EU residency for production logs — we confirmed we can configure a region-specific bucket and provide snapshot exports.
- Log sample: Ben shared process for masked samples — we can provide a 7-day sample with IP/UID hashed and payloads truncated. Requires standard replay job and the small redaction script. Estimated turnaround: 3 business days after confirm.
- KMS/HSM: Hannah confirmed support for customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) and discussed envelope encryption. HSM-level attestation is available via our Hosted Private package — we noted a follow-up for legal to confirm exact requirements.
- Evidence artifacts: Marissa listed items we’ll supply: architecture diagram (PDF), identity access matrix (XLSX), CAIQ mapped answers (CAIQ-v3-filled-template.xlsx), SOC2 control matrix (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- Action owners & deadlines:
  - Marissa: Upload CAIQ mapped answers and architecture diagram to shared folder (deadline: 2026-05-20 EOD).
  - Ben: Run masked log extract and deliver log-sample-instructions.pdf with sample files (deadline: 2026-05-21 COB).
  - Hannah: Open support ticket to legal for HSM/attestation details; confirm any extra contractual language (deadline: 2026-05-20).
- Next steps: EquatorX will confirm whether procurement wants the artifacts via HubSpot attachment or a signed DocuSign bundle. Priya to advise by 5/19.

This is a fairly standard CAIQ intake; main blockers are confirmation of EU residency and HSM attestation level.

Regards,
Hannah
